ORDER This is second bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant in connection with Crime No.310/2022, registered at Police Station Ganj, District Betul (M.P.), for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 409 of IPC.
2. First application filed by applicant was dismissed as withdrawn.
3. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely been implicated in the case.
It is the Bank Manager, who has committed the crime.
Applicant was only the collector of installments.
It is submitted that small loans were given to customers by finance company.
Petitioner only used to collect the installment.

4. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that applicant had forged documents in respect of 42 customers and has obtained loan of Rs.9,56,842/- and said amount has also been withdrawn by him.

In these circumstances,
application be dismissed.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.Considering facts and circumstances of the case particularly the fact that investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been filed, bail application filed by applicant is allowed on condition that applicant will deposit Rs.7,00,000/- (Rupees Seven Lacs only) before the trial court under protest.

Said amount deposited by the applicant will be kept in FDR by the concerned court and shall be subject to final judgment which will be passed by the trial court. .
7.

It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C as per rules.
